subject: microbiology
title: Haemophilus influenzae Type b, X and V Factors and Satellitism

steps.tx: **Haemophilus influenzae** is a small pleomorphic gram negative coccobacillus needing blood factors, capsulated types a to f (**type b, polyribosylribitol phosphate capsule, invasive champion**) and non typeable strains of otitis and COPD. It does not cause influenza (virus does), a naming accident from 1892 influenza pandemic sputum. Biotypes and outer membrane patterns were once the fingerprinting tools before serotyping and sequencing became routine.
steps.say: Type b capsule invades blood and meninges; non typeable stays in ears and bronchi.

left.title: Organism portrait
points: Capsule types a to f, b most virulent

right.title: Disease split
points: Hib: meningitis, epiglottitis, bacteraemia, cellulitis (pre vaccine)
Type a rising in some populations post Hib
Biogroup aegyptius conjunctivitis and Brazilian purpuric fever

steps.tx: **X factor is haemin** (for cytochromes and catalase synthesis) and **V factor is NAD** (coenzyme), both supplied by lysed blood in chocolate agar, absent intact on blood agar except when Staphylococcus aureus feeds colonies (**satellitism**, staph secretes V and lyses red cells for X in miniature). Factor discs on nutrient agar read needs.
steps.say: X is haemin, V is NAD; colonies hug the staph streak that feeds them V.

left.title: Factor needs
points: Discs and strips on factor free agar

right.title: Satellitism
points: V diffuses, red cells lysed locally for X

steps.tx: **Hib disease before vaccine** was childhood meningitis peak 6 to 18 months, epiglottitis with thumbprint swelling and drooling (airway first, no tongue depressor), buccal cellulitis, septic arthritis; **conjugate vaccine** (PRP conjugated to tetanus or meningococcal protein) collapsed invasive disease where coverage holds, rifampicin prophylaxis for household young contacts.
steps.say: Drooling toddler leaning forward: secure epiglottitis airway before any culture.

right.title: Prevention
points: Rifampicin household under 4 and immunocompromised contacts
Type a surveillance in Indigenous populations

steps.tx: **Hib diagnosis** (CSF gram negative coccobacilli, culture chocolate and blood with satellitism, latex and PCR antigen where antibiotics pre treated, blood cultures) and beta lactamase ampicillin resistance plus rare BLNAR, ceftriaxone therapy with dexamethasone meningitis rules shared pneumococcus.
steps.say: Coccobacilli in a toddler's CSF still mean Hib until PCR and culture answer.

left.title: Bench chain
points: X and V discs required both

steps.tx: **Non typeable Haemophilus** rewires COPD exacerbations, otitis media (with Moraxella and pneumococcus trio), sinusitis and maternal neonatal infections, beta lactamase common, biofilm in middle ear and bronchiectasis, vaccines elusive (surface variation) though protein D carrier in one pneumococcal vaccine gave partial otitis data.
steps.say: NTHi lacks capsule and vaccine, so ears and bronchi keep meeting it.

right.title: Management echoes
points: Amoxicillin clavulanate by beta lactamase prevalence

steps.tx: **Haemophilus ducreyi preview** (next lesson) shares X only need and school of fish gram chains; aggregatibacter and Kingella (HACEK endocarditis), Pasteurella animal bites round the fastidious gram negative bench. Factor requirements are identity here.
steps.say: X alone means ducreyi territory; X plus V influenzae; V alone parainfluenzae.

right.title: HACEK echo
points: Prolonged incubation largely historical with modern bottles

steps.tx: **Epiglottitis after Hib era** is now more adult and other organism (streptococci, staph, non typeable, type a) but the management (no agitation, theatre intubation with ENT, ceftriaxone) unchanged. Vaccine shifted epidemiology, not airway law.
steps.say: Vaccines changed the organism list, never the airway first rule.

right.title: After airway
points: Extubation by leak and direct view days
Household rifampicin logic for Hib confirmed

steps.tx: **Carriage and replacement after Hib vaccine** (type b carriage nearly vanished where coverage high, non b serotypes and NTHi proportions rising relatively, invasive a in some Indigenous children) teaches surveillance never retires after vaccine victories. Surveillance must therefore continue even in countries celebrating elimination of invasive type b disease.
steps.say: Remove b and watch a and non typeable fill the stage more slowly.

left.title: Post vaccine shifts
points: Invasive Hib down over 95 percent good programmes
